newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW - Pacific, Enova mulls link with marketer.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Pacific, Enova mulls link with marketer.

text.p: Energy Pacific, the joint venture launched last week by Pacific Enterprises and Enova Corp, will first focus on natural gas marketing, but an alliance with a power marketer is being considered, the venture's president told Reuters.
Eric Nelson, president of Energy Pacific, said the venture will be "offering gas commodity and other services," with the California market the initial target.
But he noted "the market is moving in the direction of companies wanting to buy energy from one source. The longer we wait to offer that, the harder it will get to compete."
